method: Computer Use skill in two stages: built native preview for typed Unicode and Save As; final packaged portable app for visual layouts, palette, focus mode and portable profile. Isolated owned profiles and synthetic documents only.
checks: Dark and light layouts visually inspected
Native Ctrl+F query selected the expected text and match count
Typed English and Devanagari text visibly
Real native Save As dialog saved a new QA text file
Saved UTF-8 bytes matched typed content; dirty indicator cleared
Packaged command palette populated, filtered and executed Light/Dark theme
F11 entered focus mode and Escape restored chrome
Actual portable marker used adjacent data profile; settings saved there
Four actual app captures saved for the product page
not_claimed: Exhaustive screen-reader, keyboard focus, IME/RTL or complex-script shaping coverage
Save/Discard/Cancel failure matrix and every native picker/installer page
Split view, full virtual large files or all original proposed features
